messages.subject: Penrose v Caldervale - CMC directions and Scott Schedule
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Greaves,

Ahead of the CMC on 2 October, we'd like to agree directions. We propose Model C extended disclosure, a single joint intralogistics expert (or sequential party experts with a joint statement), and a Scott Schedule for the competing money claims. We enclose a draft Scott Schedule and a draft directions order. A five-day trial estimate seems realistic. Grateful for your client's position.

Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0500
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Penrose v Caldervale - CMC directions and Scott Schedule
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Whitfield,

We agree Model C and the Scott Schedule in principle. We do not agree a single joint expert - this is a case for party experts given the technical disagreement - but we accept a joint statement following sequential exchange. We agree a five-day estimate. We'll exchange a redlined directions order tomorrow.

Martin Greaves
